campaigns.title: The persisted edge kind is the edge's kind, and a missing one is refused

mutants.breaks: the store reads the key the engine does not write, so every edge is stored as CALLS -- measured before the fix as 108 CONTAINS edges all typed CALLS, a call graph the repository never had

mutants.old: if kind not in {k.value for k in EdgeKind}:
mutants.breaks: a missing or undeclared kind is written to the column instead of refused, so a None or a typo becomes an edge type no reader can interpret and no gate can see
